preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range from 1 to n.
No self-loops or multiple edges are present.

preconditions.expression: The input graph is a tree
preconditions.description: The graph is connected and has exactly n - 1 edges, thus forming a tree.
The integer written on each vertex can be any integer with an absolute value less than or equal to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of operations required to make all integers written on the vertices of the tree equal to zero.
